name: exponentiate in a group whose order only the key holder knows
mechanism: raise the message to a public exponent modulo a product of two secret primes; only someone who knows the primes knows the group order and can compute the inverse exponent that undoes the operation; the same pair of exponents, applied in the other order, produces and checks a signature

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'RSA' in section Computer science / Cryptography:

requires: a modulus whose factorisation is secret
fails_when: deterministic without padding; broken if the modulus is factored
